# posthog-js

`posthog-js-1.438.21.no-external.js` is the `array.no-external` browser build of [posthog-js](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog-js) 1.438.21, served by this site so the page does not load it from a CDN.

That build does not load further scripts from PostHog. The source map comment was removed so the browser does not request a map file.

posthog-js is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. The license text shipped with that version is in `LICENSE`. The package metadata also notes MIT-licensed code among its dependencies; the Apache-2.0 license above covers this browser build as published by PostHog.
